verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a product analytics platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Mixpanel offering a self-hosted or on-prem deployment: the docs describe a hosted service with EU data residency, warehouse connectors, export APIs and a hosted MCP server, all of which are adjacent features. The community report of a company building its own BigQuery/Kubernetes replacement is a user-side workaround, not a product capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
